register.description: The Global Event Mapping register controls the egress global event index for this unmapped event. This register may also be optionally used to directly set an interrupt status bit by using the irqmode flag.

bitfield.description: IRQ Mode Flag. When set, this register act like a mapper with bitnum in 5:0 and regnum in 14:6. Reset Source: srst_n
Global event index. This field specifies the index of the outgoing global event. Set to 0xFFFF to disable. Reset Source: srst_n
